indexes.expression: CREATE INDEX outbox_unpublished_order_idx ON public.outbox_messages USING btree (occurred_at, id) WHERE (published_at IS NULL)
CREATE INDEX pending_reference_idx ON public.wager_transactions USING btree (status, created_at) WHERE ((status)::text = 'PENDING_REFERENCE'::text)
CREATE INDEX wager_transactions_pending_due_idx ON public.wager_transactions USING btree (status, reference_next_attempt_at, reference_expires_at) WHERE ((status)::text = 'PENDING_REFERENCE'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX wager_transactions_reference_unique_idx ON public.wager_transactions USING btree (reference_transaction_id) WHERE (reference_transaction_id IS NOT NULL)

checks.definition: CHECK (((((direction)::text = 'CREDIT'::text) AND (balance_after = (balance_before + amount))) OR (((direction)::text = 'DEBIT'::text) AND (balance_after = (balance_before - amount)))))
